name: InceptionLRT: Web3 Educational Threads
description: A series of Twitter/X threads that break down Ethereum restaking for a general audience. Complex topics including liquid restaking tokens, shared security and modular networks were translated into clear narratives using simple language, visual storytelling and relatable analogies.

name: YouNick - Corporate Website
description: YouNick is a multidisciplinary technology and innovation company, and this is its digital home. The site brings brands, products, software, AI, energy and ventures into one clear narrative - "We build things that matter." Designed and developed as a bold, editorial corporate site with structured typography, strong motion, and a system that scales across every venture.

name: YouNick Studio - Creative & Digital Studio Website
description: YouNick Studio is the creative and digital arm of YouNick. This site is built to position the studio for ambitious brands - problem-first messaging, a full capability breakdown from brand strategy to web design and development, selected work, process, and the team behind it. Designed to feel calm, editorial and conversion-focused.

name: YouNick Energy - Solar Company Website
description: YouNick Energy makes reliable solar power accessible to Nigerian homes and businesses. This website leads with trust - verified engineers, honest guidance and quality equipment - and walks visitors from first assessment through design, installation and long-term support. Clear service sections, a solar assessment CTA, and a contact flow built around real enquiries.

name: YouNick Energy App - Solar Planning Web App
description: The YouNick Energy App is a flagship product experience - a solar planning web app that helps users understand their energy needs, size a solar system, and explore products and providers before they buy. Features load audits, budget-based planning, generator comparison, ROI estimation and an AI energy advisor, packaged in a clean, focused product UI.

name: Crop Yield AI - Predictive Farming Web App
description: Crop Yield AI is a data-driven web app for predicting crop yields from farm inputs and environmental factors. Built as a focused product UI with clear input flows and readable results, it turns agricultural data into actionable forecasting - applied AI product thinking from design to deployment.

name: Bashira Oyiza Sadiq - Personal Portfolio Website
description: A clean personal portfolio and CV site for Bashira Oyiza Sadiq, a support and operations professional. Purpose-built to convert - strong personal positioning, a measurable track record, clear services, and a straightforward "Let's Work Together" path for remote roles.

name: Knowledge Chain® Visual Identity & Guideline
description: A full visual identity for a blockchain learning platform that treats knowledge as an asset. The system balances trust and structure with a sense of decentralization, designed to work across digital platforms, educational products and NFT applications.

name: YouNick Studio® Brand Identity & Guideline
description: The brand identity behind YouNick Studio, the creative and digital arm of YouNick. A complete system covering logo, typography, color and usage guidelines, built to feel calm and confident across every studio touchpoint.

name: Gurasa Dotcom Pitch-Deck
description: A packaging concept and pitch deck that reimagines Gurasa, a beloved Hausa flatbread, as a modern shelf-ready product. The box design uses earthy tones, subtle Hausa patterns and clear information hierarchy to balance cultural roots with contemporary retail branding.

name: Apex Bit (Crypto)
description: A contemporary logo design for a cryptocurrency brand. Clean geometric forms and precision typography communicate stability, trust and forward momentum for a tech-savvy audience.

name: Carousel Post for Construction Company
description: An Instagram carousel post for a construction company, designed to present services and project highlights in a clear, structured sequence. Strong typography and a restrained color palette keep every slide readable and professional.

name: Paradise Wave Logo
description: A logo for a modern music label blending tropical motifs with contemporary soundscapes. A palm and wave icon sits inside a rounded frame, paired with a bold wordmark and a gold and black palette for a premium presence across digital and print.

name: Twitter Thread Design 001
description: A visual template system for long-form Twitter/X threads. The layout organizes technical content into clear, scrollable slides with consistent typography and spacing to keep readers engaged from the first post to the last.

name: Knots & Klips (Hair Accessories Brand)
description: A logo for a hair accessories brand aimed at fashion-forward young adults. The design blends contemporary trends with timeless elegance, delivering a versatile mark that scales cleanly across packaging, social media and product applications.

name: Instagram Carousel for Social Server
description: An Instagram carousel for Social Server, structured to deliver a multi-slide story with clear pacing and visual hierarchy. The design keeps messaging punchy and readable while matching the brand tone.

name: Pastries Brand
description: A brand identity for a pastries business, covering the logo and core visual elements. Warm tones and approachable styling keep the brand inviting and consistent across packaging, menus and social content.

name: BetHub Central
description: A brand identity for a betting and gaming platform. The system focuses on clarity and energy, with a distinctive logo and color palette built to stand out across digital platforms, promotions and app interfaces.

name: OMG Logo Design
description: A bold logo built around the initials OMG. The mark prioritizes clean geometry and strong recognition at any size, suitable for digital, print and merchandise applications.

name: SPOTIFY LOGO REDESIGN
description: A concept redesign of the Spotify logo exploring a sleeker, more modern direction. The study refines the mark silhouette and rhythm to reflect the energy of music while keeping the identity instantly recognizable.

name: Dynamic Youtube Thumbnail Designs
description: A collection of YouTube thumbnail designs built to maximize click-through. Bold headlines, high-contrast imagery and a consistent template system keep every video on-brand while standing out in the feed.

name: Outlaws VII
description: A brand identity for Outlaws VII, built around a bold, unapologetic visual language. The system covers logo design, typography and core brand applications for a strong, distinctive presence.

name: Clothing Brand Logo Design
description: A logo for an apparel brand, designed to work across garments, tags and digital channels. The mark is clean, scalable and versatile enough for embroidery, print and social use.

name: Blue Giants Promotions Logo
description: A logo for an online promotional and advertising company. The design plays on the name with unexpected color and scale, giving the brand a confident, eye-catching identity.

name: Emperor Music Company
description: A logo for a music holding company that oversees multiple subsidiary labels. The identity communicates authority and cohesion, designed to sit at the top of a family of music brands.

name: Construction Service Logo
description: A logo for a construction services company, built on strength and reliability. Solid geometric forms and clear typography work across signage, vehicles and documentation.

name: Tunnel The Brand
description: A minimalist logo for a multiventure brand. The mark reduces the idea of a tunnel to a simple geometric form, creating a flexible identity that stretches across the brand different business lines.

name: Oyizami Enterprise & Table Water Logo
description: A logo design for Oyizami Enterprise and its table water line. The identity balances a corporate feel with the freshness expected of a water product, built to work across packaging, labels and business materials.

name: DKV Travels
description: A brand identity for a travel business, covering the logo and visual elements. The system communicates movement and reliability while staying flexible across booking platforms, social media and print.

name: Coffee Shop Logo
description: A logo for a coffee shop, crafted to feel warm and inviting while remaining clean and modern. The mark works across cups, signage, menus and social profiles.

name: The Mask Man
description: A logo concept built around the character of a masked figure. The mark leans into mystery and personality, designed to be distinctive and instantly recognizable.

name: AWR Solutions Logo Design
description: A logo for a home hardware solutions brand. The design communicates dependability and practical expertise through clean structure and legible typography.

name: Video Gaming Brand Logo Design
description: A logo for Spindie, a video gaming brand. The concept draws from the gaming pad, a motorcycle and a fidget spinner, unified into a single dynamic mark built around the idea of spin.

name: Brand Guideline Design
description: A brand guideline laying out a complete visual system: logo usage, typography, color, imagery and application rules. The document keeps every touchpoint consistent and easy to apply.

name: Fortunata Boat Logo
description: A logo for Fortunata, a boat brand. The mark combines nautical cues with a clean modern form, designed to read clearly on vessels, merchandise and digital channels.

name: Yankee Burger Social Media Campaign
description: A social media campaign for a modern burger brand, covering a promotional event flyer and a coordinated Instagram grid. Bold typography and warm food photography keep the feed consistent while giving each post its own energy.
